Description: Susceptible individuals become exposed through contact with infectious individuals.
Exposed individuals progress to presymptomatic infectious state.
Exposed individuals are quarantined to prevent further spread.
Presymptomatic individuals develop mild to moderate symptoms.
Mild to moderate cases that worsen are admitted to hospital.
Mild to moderate cases recover without hospital admission.
Severe cases are admitted to hospital.
Severe cases recover without ICU admission.
Hospitalized individuals progress to ICU care.
Individuals in ICU recover enough to move to regular hospital care.
Individuals in ICU who succumb to the infection.
Individuals recover from the infection after ICU care.
